de: Die Bühne stellt das Innere des Venusberges (Hörselberges bei Eisenach) dar. Weite Grotte, welche sich im Hintergrunde durch eine Biegung nach rechts wie unabsehbar dahinzieht. Vor einer nach links aufwärts sich dehnenden Grottenöffnung, aus welcher ein zarter rosiger Dämmer heraus scheint, liegt im Vordergrunde Venus auf einem reichen Lager, vor ihr, das Haupt in ihrem Schoße, die Harfe zur Seite, Tannhäuser, halb knieend. Das Lager umgeben, in reizender Verschlingung gelagert, die drei Grazien . Zur Seite und hinter dem Lager zahlreiche schlafende Amoretten, wild über und neben einander gelagert einen verworrenen Knäul bildend, wie Kinder, die, von einer Balgerei ermattet, eingeschlafen sind. ja: The stage represents the interior of the Venusberg (the Hörselberg near Eisenach). A vast grotto curves to the right at the back and seems to stretch on endlessly. From a fissured opening through which dim daylight enters, a greenish waterfall plunges down the full height of the grotto, foaming wildly over the rocks. From the basin that receives its waters, a stream flows towards the distant background, where it gathers into a lake; there, bathing Najaden (water nymphs) and Sirenen reclining on the banks can be seen. On both sides of the grotto are irregular rocky ledges covered with marvellous, coral-like tropical plants. In the foreground, before a grotto opening that extends upwards to the left and gives out a delicate rosy half-light, Venus lies on a sumptuous couch; Tannhäuser is half kneeling before her, his head resting in her lap, with his harp at his side. Around the couch lie the three Grazien, their bodies charmingly intertwined. Beside and behind the couch, numerous sleeping Amoretten (cupids) lie haphazardly over and beside one another in a tangled heap, like children who have fallen asleep exhausted by a rough-and-tumble. The whole foreground is lit by a magical reddish light shining through from below; the emerald green of the waterfall and the white of its foaming waves stand out vividly through this light. The distant background, including the shores of the lake, is illuminated as if by moonlight through an ethereally radiant blue haze. As the curtain rises, the young men are still reclining over their cups on the raised ledges; they now immediately follow the enticing gestures of the Nymphen (nymphs) and hurry down to them. The Nymphen (nymphs) had already begun an inviting round dance around the foaming basin of the waterfall, intended to draw the young men to them. The couples find one another and intermingle: seeking, fleeing, and charming teasing enliven the dance.
